title: Motorcyclist Gets 8th OWI After Police Chase
description:
On January 13, 2021, a Juneau County Deputy attempted to stop a motorcycle for a traffic violation near Hustler, WI. The deputy activated his lights and siren, however, the motorcyclist accelerated in an attempt to flee. Later on, another deputy came in contact with the motorcyclist and was able to take him into custody. When deputies questioned the suspect for alcohol in his system, he did nothing but tell the raw eggless truth...
